findings.issue: 19.6.6 event 15 was suppressed wholesale as unobservable undefinition, but items (b), (c) and (e) preserve nonpointer default-initialized subcomponents of INTENT(OUT) dummies, their actual arguments and function results
findings.resolution: event 15 split into unobservable undefinition versus observable default-initialized subcomponent exceptions; sentinel plan x%a = 1 gives d%a == 5 inside and x%a == 5 after, x%b unasserted, plus a function-result analogue
